VB Scoreboard Basic creates network of connected scoreboards. All devices on the same WiFi network are synchronized and can be used either to display and adjust volleyball score. This way, one of the devices can be used for changing the score and any number of connected devices will show it to different parts of the audience. 

Here is what VB Scoreboard Basic can do:

• Displays and adjusts score 
• Network links between scoreboards for displaying and adjusting score of the same match from multiple devices 
• Web scorecast
• Support for bluetooth remote. You can be in the game and keep the score without running to the board in each scored point. Check supported remotes here: http://volleybe.com/scoreboard/bluetooth/ 
• Scoreboard browser for choosing match to be displayed and controlled 
• Scoreboards will expire after period of inactivity 
• Change of team names 
• Change team colors 
• Start and stop game timer 
• Double tap nullifies timer 
• Display match statistics 
• Share Stats by email, Facebook, Twitter 
• Provide indication of serving team
• Tap on the arrow is changing direction

The FEI Sport Manager is tailored towards FEI Athletes, Organising Committees and FEI Officials.

FEI Athletes can:

- Browse through upcoming events and add them to the wish list
- Set and modify the priority of each event
- Set and modify the name or number of horses
- View upcoming entries and their status
- Receive automatic notifications at the start and end of a selection period

Organising Committees can:

- Consult their event's status and details
- Accept, reject, consult and manage Jumping entries
- Download event related documents

FEI Officials can:

- Consult the details of event they are assigned to
- Consult the list of entries and the status of each one
- Download event related documents
